title: Collapsing every group says 'This folder is empty' and removes the headers; an empty folder has no right-click menu
problem: `render_content` shows the centered message whenever `self.rows.is_empty() && !self.loading && !self.searching` (src/finder/mod.rs:3236-3264), and that branch is checked before any view is drawn. (1) A collapsed group's items are removed from `rows` (crates/fffinder-core/src/grouping.rs:177-180, src/finder/groups.rs:129-144), so collapsing the only group, or the last expanded one, makes `rows` empty: the whole view, group headers included, is replaced by 'No Items / This folder is empty.' and there is no header left to click to expand again. Because collapsed groups are remembered per tab across folders by design (docs/manual.md:320; `location_changed` at mod.rs:900-926 does not clear `collapsed_groups`), collapsing 'Folder' and then opening a folder that contains only folders also shows a non-empty folder as empty. Both views can already draw header-only content (`list_line_count` = rows + groups, groups.rs:200-221; `icon_lines` emits a Header line for an empty range, groups.rs:46-62). (2) The message element (`render_message`, mod.rs:3394-3416) has no context menu: `background_menu` is only attached inside `render_icons`, `render_list` and `render_columns` (src/finder/views.rs:429-432, 657-662, 1059-1062). Right-clicking in an empty folder, exactly where New Folder, Paste and Show Hidden Files are wanted, does nothing. (The same reviewer's third point, the wrong text when a filter hides everything, is merged into empty-state-messages.)
proposal: In mod.rs `render_content`: (1) treat the view as empty only when there are no rows AND no group headers: change the two checks at mod.rs:3236 and 3267 to `self.rows.is_empty() && self.groups.is_empty()` so a fully collapsed list or icon view still renders its headers through `render_list`/`render_icons`. (2) Attach the background menu to the non-error message: `self.render_message(..).context_menu({ let view = cx.entity(); move |menu, window, cx| menus::background_menu(&view, menu, window, cx) })`; `background_menu` already adapts to Trash, search and no-folder (src/finder/menus.rs:374-495). Optionally make the status bar count (src/finder/bars.rs:327) add collapsed groups' `total` so it doesn't read '0 items'.
original_test_plan: Headless UI tests. (a) Extend `groups_collapse_and_hide_their_items` (tests/controls.rs:1722): after `set_group_by(Some(GroupKey::Kind))`, click every `group-<label>` header; assert `ui.names().is_empty()` and `ui.exists("group-Folder")` is still true (false today), then click it and assert Projects is back; repeat after `ui.click("view-icons")`. (b) Create an empty dir in the fixture, `ui.go_to(&empty)`, `ui.right_click_at("content", at(120., 120.))`, assert `ui.menu_open()` and that `menu_labels()` contains New Folder and Show Hidden Files; `ui.click_menu_item("New Folder")` and assert `empty/untitled folder` exists.
original_risks: With all groups collapsed the list is header-only: check the filler-row math (`visible.saturating_sub(len + 1)`, views.rs:545-546) and that Select All and the arrow keys are no-ops on zero rows. The background menu on the message must keep honouring `take_item_menu_click`, which it does since there are no items.

verifier.claim_check:
Both halves hold as described; I found no handler elsewhere that covers either case.

**(1) Collapsing every group replaces the view with the empty-folder message.**
- `render_content` picks the message on `self.rows.is_empty() && !self.loading && !self.searching` (src/finder/mod.rs:3236), before any view is drawn, and ends at "No Items / This folder is empty." (mod.rs:3262).
- A collapsed group contributes no rows: `arrange` only extends `arranged` when `!span.collapsed` (crates/fffinder-core/src/grouping.rs:177-180), called from `group_rows` (src/finder/groups.rs:129-144). With every group collapsed, `rows` is empty while `groups` is not.
- The headers are drawn only inside `render_list` / `render_icon_line` (src/finder/views.rs:620-622, 450-453), so they vanish with the view and there is nothing left to click.
- `collapsed_groups` is cleared only when the Group By key changes (groups.rs:156-158). `location_changed` (mod.rs:900-926) does not touch it, and docs/manual.md:320 documents that as intended ("Each tab remembers which groups are collapsed until you choose another key").
- So collapsing "Folder" and then opening a folder that holds only folders shows it as empty. The same path gives "No Results", "No Recent Files" and "The Trash Is Empty" for non-empty searches, Recents and Trash.
- The only ways back are choosing another Group By key, turning Use Groups off, or switching to Columns or Gallery. Toggling Use Groups back on restores the same collapsed set (groups.rs:179-180).
- Header-only drawing already works:
  - `list_line` returns `Header(g)` for `line < groups.len()` and `None` (a filler row) after it when all ranges are `0..0` (groups.rs:207-221).
  - `icon_lines` emits a Header for an empty range, pinned by the unit test at groups.rs:321-335.

**(2) An empty folder has no right-click menu.**
- The message branch is `self.render_message(&title, &detail, cx).into_any_element()` (mod.rs:3264); `render_message` (mod.rs:3394-3416) is a plain `Div`.
- `background_menu` is attached in exactly three places: views.rs:429-432 (icons), 657-662 (list body), 1059-1062 (columns). The `#content` wrapper (mod.rs:3278-3383) has none, and no other `context_menu(` or right-button handler in `src/` covers the content area.
- docs/manual.md:822 promises the menu on "empty space in a view". Per manual.md:847, Linux and Windows have no menu bar, and the Actions menu has no Paste item, so in an empty folder Paste is reachable only by Ctrl+V.

**Docs, changelog and tests.** CHANGELOG.md has no entry for either. No test pins the current behaviour: `groups_collapse_and_hide_their_items` (tests/controls.rs:1722) collapses one group only, and the three empty-space menu tests (controls.rs:582, file_ops.rs:294, basics.rs:1146) all use non-empty folders.
verifier.implementation_notes:
The proposal is right as written. Concrete plan, with two additions (Trash "Empty…" and docs).

1. **Predicate in `render_content`** (src/finder/mod.rs). Add a helper on `Finder`, e.g. in groups.rs:
   `pub(super) fn shows_nothing(&self) -> bool { self.rows.is_empty() && self.groups.is_empty() }`
   - Use it at mod.rs:3236 (`self.shows_nothing() && !self.loading && !self.searching`) and at mod.rs:3267 (the skeleton branch).
   - This is safe for the other views: `group_rows` clears `groups` whenever grouping is off or the view is Columns or Gallery (groups.rs:131-134), and it runs on every `rebuild_rows` (mod.rs:1267), including from `set_view_mode` (mod.rs:2118).
   - The filter runs before grouping (mod.rs:1261 then 1267), so a filter that hides everything still yields no groups and still shows the message.

2. **Context menu on the non-error message** (mod.rs:3264):
   `self.render_message(&title, &detail, cx).context_menu({ let view = cx.entity(); move |menu, window, cx| menus::background_menu(&view, menu, window, cx) }).into_any_element()`
   - `ContextMenuExt` is implemented for any `InteractiveElement + ParentElement + Styled`, so a `Div` without an id works; the id falls back to the call site (gpui-component-0.8.1/src/menu/context_menu.rs:32-43). One call site means no shared-state problem.
   - The wrapper forwards the inner div's `size_full`, so the hitbox covers the whole file area.
   - Menu actions (NewFolder, Paste, ToggleHidden, Refresh, SelectAll) are handled on the `#finder` root (mod.rs:3056-3104), which is an ancestor of the message, the same as for the list and icon menus.
   - Leave the error branch (mod.rs:3224-3235) alone.
   - `background_menu` already adapts: Trash gives a lone "Empty Trash…", no folder drops New Folder and Paste (src/finder/menus.rs:387-427).

3. **Trash "Empty…" (addition).** Both the bar button (src/finder/trash.rs:395) and the menu item (menus.rs:392) are disabled on `rows.is_empty()`. Once headers show for a fully collapsed Trash, "Empty…" would sit disabled beside a non-empty Trash. Switch both to `shows_nothing()`.

4. **Do not clear `collapsed_groups` on navigation.** manual.md:320 documents the per-tab memory; the fix is to show the headers.

5. **Status bar: leave it out.** `count = self.rows.len()` (src/finder/bars.rs:327) already means "visible items" for a partly collapsed view, and "N of M selected" uses the same number. Adding the groups' `total` would also be inexact, because `total` counts top-level blocks only (grouping.rs:176) while `rows` includes open folders' children. If wanted later, capture `rows.len()` just before `group_rows` instead.

6. **Docs.** Add a sentence to manual.md:320 (when every group is collapsed only the headers show) and to the Empty-space menu section near manual.md:822 (an empty folder's message area opens the menu too). Add two "### Fixed" entries under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md.

**Zero-row paths I checked, no change needed:**
- `Selection::move_by` returns on `len == 0` (src/model.rs:292).
- `move_to_end` uses `checked_sub` (mod.rs:1846).
- `select_all(0)` is a no-op.
- `grid_step` returns `None` when no range contains the index (groups.rs:81).
- `type_to_select` picks `None` on empty names.
- `rows_in_box` / `tiles_in_box` only insert Row and Tiles lines (src/finder/marquee.rs:204-207, 230).
- Filler math `visible.saturating_sub(len + 1)` with `len = groups.len()` matches today's grouped list (views.rs:543-546).
verifier.test_plan:
Headless UI tests in tests/controls.rs, using `Fixture`, `Ui`, `at` and `item_id` from tests/common/mod.rs. Both tests run on Linux; none of the code involved is platform-specific.

**(a) New test `collapsing_every_group_keeps_its_headers`**, next to `groups_collapse_and_hide_their_items` (controls.rs:1722). A new test is better than extending that one, whose later assertions depend on the groups being expanded.
- Setup: `Fixture::new("groups-all")`, `Ui::open`, `ui.click("view-list")`, `ui.update(|f, _, cx| f.set_group_by(Some(GroupKey::Kind), cx))`.
- For each label in `ui.read(|f| f.group_headers())`, `ui.click(SharedString::from(format!("group-{label}")))`.
- Assert `ui.names().is_empty()`, `ui.exists("group-Folder")` (false today) and `group_headers().len() == 4`.
- Press `down` and dispatch `SelectAll`; assert `ui.selected().is_empty()`.
- `ui.click("view-icons")`; assert `ui.exists("group-Folder")` still holds.
- Click `group-Folder`; assert `ui.names() == ["Projects"]`.
- Navigation case: back in the list with only "Folder" collapsed, `ui.go_to(&fx.path("Projects"))` (it holds only `atlas/`). Assert `ui.names().is_empty()` and `ui.exists("group-Folder")`; click the header and assert `ui.names() == ["atlas"]`.

**(b) New test `an_empty_folder_has_the_empty_space_menu`**, next to `context_menus_on_items_and_empty_space` (controls.rs:582).
- `std::fs::create_dir(fx.path("Empty"))` before `Ui::open`, then `ui.go_to(&fx.path("Empty"))`.
- `ui.right_click_at("content", at(120., 120.))`; assert `ui.menu_open()` (false today).
- Assert `ui.menu_labels()` contains "New Folder" and "Show Hidden Files".
- `ui.click_menu_item("New Folder")`; assert `fx.path("Empty/untitled folder").is_dir()`; `ui.press("escape")` to end the rename, as the existing test does.

The existing tests in tests/controls.rs, tests/basics.rs and tests/file_ops.rs should be unaffected: none collapses all groups or right-clicks an empty folder.
verifier.risks:
Low.
- **Stale headers during a load.** With `loading` true and the previous location fully collapsed, the old headers show instead of the skeleton until the listing arrives. This matches how stale rows already show while loading.
- **Status bar reads "0 items" beside a header that says "Folder 12".** This is the existing visible-count meaning; I recommend leaving it rather than adding the inexact `total`.
- **Empty Trash and Recents get a sparse menu.** Right-clicking an empty Trash shows a single disabled "Empty Trash…"; an empty Recents shows the menu without New Folder or Paste. Harmless and consistent with the list view.
- **"No Results" during a search inside a folder offers New Folder.** The results list's background menu already does the same.
- **Stale `item_menu_at`.** `take_item_menu_click` could suppress the menu only if a leftover item click sits at the identical pixel; that edge exists today in the other views.
- **Gallery still has no background menu.** `render_gallery` (src/finder/views.rs:1217-1273) attaches none; out of scope here.

orchestrator_notes: From the reviewer of 'empty-state-messages' (f60d2e4, on the trunk; read its done record's note for this brief first: it says exactly which term of render_content's message branch to swap and where the context menu goes). Two small things they found in the same functions, to fix here only if each is a few lines and certainly right, with a test, else leave them and say so: a results view sent from Nushell that has no items left says 'No Items / This folder is empty.' though it isn't a folder (`empty_message` in src/finder/mod.rs, the rule for places that aren't searches); and in the Trash, with a filter that hides every item, the Trash bar's Empty… button and the menu's item are off because they go by `rows.is_empty()`, although the Trash has items.
